description: Shared tokens for feed and project metadata. Tokens are referenced from social.craftsky.project.defs#projectCommon.craftType, social.craftsky.project.defs#projectCommon.status, and social.craftsky.project.defs#pattern.difficulty via knownValues. knownValues is open: new tokens can be added here without breaking existing records.

beginner.description: Pattern suitable for newcomers to the craft.

confidentBeginner.description: Pattern suitable for crafters comfortable with the basic techniques of the craft.

intermediate.description: Pattern assumes reliable command of core techniques and may introduce more involved construction.

advanced.description: Pattern assumes strong skill and may require complex or uncommon techniques.
